en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a coastal city with a long, wide pier or waterfront promenade extending into the water. Low-rise buildings line the shore, and a range of mountains with snow-capped peaks rises in the background. A few small human figures walk along the pier. Greek and French captions are printed at the bottom, and a small publisher's logo appears in the lower right corner.
